Card Tooltip -- Themed Hover Text

Test fixture for #283: `tooltip`/`hoverText` on `<x-card>` should show a themed WB tooltip (`.x-tooltip`), not the native browser `title` tooltip.

Card with a title (heading) AND a tooltip attribute -- the themed tooltip must win; the literal `title` DOM attribute must not remain (no double native+themed tooltip on hover).
Card with the hover-text alias attribute.
Card with only a plain title attribute (no tooltip/hoverText) -- must NOT get a themed tooltip; the literal title attribute keeps working as a normal native tooltip.
